name: Beautiful Blood
source:
A young college boy lost in the woods... What could go wrong?

Life takes an unexpected turn when you find yourself in the manorhouse of two vampires - but it's not just your blood they want! Needing a human's bodily fluids to allow them to step out into the sun, you're trapped into being the life...

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=yaoi.genius.blvampire]Google Play[/url]]
